# openinfra_dataflow (Resource)

A whole data topology in one resource: database, topic, function and bucket nodes joined by replication, migration, stream and pipe edges. This is what the console's canvas edits.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `edges` (Attributes List) Data movement between nodes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--edges))
- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `nodes` (Attributes List) Endpoints on the canvas. `name` is the node id edges refer to, and doubles as the replication origin marker. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))

### Optional

- `auto_sync_tables` (Boolean) Multi-master only: keep the table *set* in sync across all members, adding a new table everywhere when it appears anywhere. Implies capturing all tables.
- `drift_detection` (Boolean) Multi-master only: run an always-on schema-drift detector that logs when members' table schemas diverge. Detection only — it never mutates schemas.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `origin_column` (String)
- `storage_class` (String) StorageClass for this resource's persistent volumes. Defaults to `longhorn`; set to your cluster's StorageClass on substrates without Longhorn (e.g. RKE2 with local-path).
- `tables` (List of String) Tables moved on every edge of this flow, e.g. `["public.orders"]`, or `["*"]` for all. Scope is per-flow; per-edge subsets are not supported.
- `version_column` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `phase` (String)
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.

<a id="nestedatt--edges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `edges`

Required:

- `from` (String) Source node name.
- `to` (String) Target node name. For replication edges the link is bidirectional.
- `type` (String) `replication`, `migration`, `stream` or `pipe`.

Optional:

- `bootstrap` (Boolean) Replication edges: create the target's tables from `from` before syncing. Defaults to `false`.
- `mode` (String) Migration edges only: `full-load`, `cdc` or `full-load-and-cdc`. Defaults to `full-load-and-cdc`.


<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Required:

- `name` (String)

Optional:

- `bucket` (String) For `role = bucket`.
- `database` (String)
- `engine` (String) For `role = database`: `postgres`, `mysql`, `mariadb` or `sqlserver`.
- `function_ref` (String) For `role = function`: the Function's name.
- `function_url` (String) For `role = function`: an explicit URL instead.
- `host` (String)
- `password_secret_ref` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes--password_secret_ref))
- `port` (Number) Defaults to `5432`.
- `prefix` (String) For `role = bucket`: key prefix.
- `role` (String) `database`, `topic`, `function` or `bucket`. Defaults to `database`.
- `schema` (String) Defaults to `public`.
- `ssl` (Boolean) Defaults to `false`.
- `username` (String)
- `x` (Number) Canvas position. Cosmetic; the console maintains it.
- `y` (Number) Canvas position. Cosmetic; the console maintains it.

<a id="nestedatt--nodes--password_secret_ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes.password_secret_ref`

Required:

- `name` (String)

Optional:

- `key` (String) Defaults to `password`.
